analyzed_vuln.description: `CacheAccess::release()` calls `fResource->release()` and then unconditionally re-reads `fResource` to check `hasRef()` / `hasNoCommandBufferUsages()`. For multiply-inherited resources like `GrMockTextureRenderTarget`, `GrGpuResource::release()` can run `onRelease()` logic that drops the last ref and destroys the object during that call path. After that, `CacheAccess::release()` dereferences a dangling `fResource` pointer, causing the heap-use-after-free seen at `GrGpuResource::release()` line 52 on the second release pass in `GrResourceCache::releaseAll()`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered during context teardown (`GrDirectContext` destructor -> `GrResourceCache::releaseAll`) when cache iteration releases resources and a resource is deleted during/after the first `release()` call but the same raw pointer is still used by `CacheAccess::release()` for post-call checks. In this PoV, fuzzed mock GPU canvas operations create a `GrMockTextureRenderTarget` via `GrMockGpu::onCreateTexture`; teardown then releases cache entries, one release path deletes the object, and a subsequent dereference of the stale pointer in `CacheAccess::release()` causes UAF.
